package lintpolicy

import "net/http"

func insecureResponse(w http.ResponseWriter) {
	http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{Name: "session", Value: "fixture"}) // G124_PRODUCTION_RESPONSE
}

func secureResponse(w http.ResponseWriter) {
	http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{Name: "session", Value: "fixture", Secure: true, HttpOnly: true, SameSite: http.SameSiteStrictMode})
}
